mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration and potential economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) and insufficient monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) signal policy misalignment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising housing starts (HOUST > 1050) signal sustained consumer demand strength, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO > 104.5) signals strengthening manufacturing activity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in nonfarm payrolls below 145,000 thousand signals labor market weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS < 145000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in GDP (GDPC1 < 16800) and industrial production (INDPRO < 105) signals broad economic weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a regression over 3 years.
